notes.title: Mad Factory Arcade Advertising
notes.content:
Hello Factory Employees

We're seeing a fantastic adoption of Mad Factory by the Retail/ VR Arcade sector! This was absolutely our goal and this subsequently directed many of our design decisions. 

We have not just put the game out there and left it at that though. During a Pilot phase here in the UK, we formed some great, close relationships with Arcade owners and listened to how they market a title. 
We correspondingly created a broad range of digital marketing assets from banners to badges, for use in Arcades in their front of house or on their game selection systems.

These are available to all Arcade owners and we invite you to get in touch so we can: 
- Learn about you and your needs
- Provide you with the front of house marketing assets that work for you. 

Please contact us via madfactory@thethirdfloorinc.com

Operators are standing by!

Best

Mike, Andy and the Mad Factory crew...
